nodes.name: WhatsApp Webhook
nodes.notes: Meta WhatsApp Cloud API webhook (POST). Responds 200 immediately so Meta does not retry.

nodes.name: WhatsApp Verify Webhook
nodes.notes: Meta calls this GET once when you register the webhook.

nodes.name: Respond Verify Token
nodes.notes: Replace REPLACE_VERIFY_TOKEN with the same token you enter in Meta.

nodes.name: Client Config
nodes.notes: EDIT PER CLIENT: business name, WhatsApp phone number ID, Slack channel and business facts (delivery, payments, returns, hours). The bot answers only from these + the products table.

nodes.name: Normalize WhatsApp Data
nodes.notes: Extracts customer_name, phone, message, message_id, timestamp. Ignores status callbacks.

nodes.name: Check Duplicate Message
nodes.notes: Stops Meta retries from getting a second reply.

nodes.name: Check Customer
nodes.notes: alwaysOutputData keeps the flow alive when no customer is found.

nodes.name: Get Customer History
nodes.notes: Last 7 days, up to 20 rows. The AI prompts sort and keep the latest 8 exchanges.

nodes.name: Get Product Information
nodes.notes: Single source of truth for the AI. For large catalogs, add a filter on product_interest/keywords.

nodes.name: Send WhatsApp Response
nodes.notes: Replace YOUR_PHONE_NUMBER_ID. Twilio alternative: swap for the Twilio node (whatsapp: prefix).

nodes.name: AI Sales Agent
nodes.notes: One agent: classifies intent + writes the reply from the products table and Client Config only.

parameters.text: ={{ JSON.stringify({ customer_name: $('Normalize WhatsApp Data').first().json.customer_name, customer_message: $('Normalize WhatsApp Data').first().json.message, recent_history: ($('Get Customer History').isExecuted ? $('Get Customer History').all().map(i => i.json).filter(r => r.id) : []).sort((a, b) => new Date(a.timestamp) - new Date(b.timestamp)).slice(-8).map(r => ({ customer: r.customer_message, assistant: r.ai_response })), business_info: { business_name: $('Client Config').first().json.business_name, delivery_areas: $('Client Config').first().json.delivery_areas, delivery_time: $('Client Config').first().json.delivery_time, delivery_charges: $('Client Config').first().json.delivery_charges, payment_methods: $('Client Config').first().json.payment_methods, return_policy: $('Client Config').first().json.return_policy, working_hours: $('Client Config').first().json.working_hours, contact_phone: $('Client Config').first().json.contact_phone }, products: $('Get Product Information').all().map(i => i.json).filter(p => p.product_name) }) }}

options.systemMessage: You are a friendly sales assistant for the business named in business_info.business_name, chatting with a customer on WhatsApp. Do two things: understand what the customer wants, and write the reply. Reply rules: 1) Use ONLY the products and business_info data provided. Never invent prices, features, discounts, availability, delivery details or policies. 2) If the answer is not in the data, say you will check with the team instead of guessing. 3) Never offer or promise discounts or special terms. 4) Keep the reply under 60 words, natural and human, plain text only - no markdown, no bullet lists. 5) Answer the question directly first; do not repeat information already given in recent_history. 6) Ask at most one useful follow-up question, only when appropriate. 7) If the customer asks for a person, a call or a demo, is upset, or needs support you cannot resolve, set needs_human to true and tell them a team member will reach out shortly. 8) Show prices exactly as stored in the data. 9) If customer_message says an image, video, document or voice note was received, say you cannot view it here, ask them to type what they need, and set needs_human to true. 10) If the customer wants to buy, ask for whichever of product, quantity and delivery address is still missing (one at a time) and say the team will confirm the order shortly. Return ONLY a JSON object with exactly these keys: reply (string - the WhatsApp message), intent (one of: product_inquiry, pricing, availability, features, purchase_intent, general_question, human_agent, support), product_interest (a product_name exactly as it appears in products, or an empty string), buying_stage (awareness | consideration | decision), is_interested (boolean), needs_human (boolean).

parameters.content:
**1. Webhook Intake & Config**

Receives incoming WhatsApp messages (and handles Meta's one-time webhook verification), then loads this client's business facts, name, phone number ID, Slack channel, delivery/payment/return info and used everywhere downstream.

**2. Normalize & Dedupe**

Extracts a clean record from the raw WhatsApp payload and checks Supabase to make sure this message hasn't already been processed (stops duplicate replies on Meta retries).

**3. Customer Lookup**

Looks up the customer by phone number and pulls their last 7 days of conversation history, or creates a new customer record if this is their first message.

**4. AI Sales Agent**

Loads the product catalog, then one AI agent classifies the customer's intent and writes a reply using only the business info and products provided — no invented prices, discounts, or policies.

**5. Score & Respond**

Scores the lead (Cold/Warm/Hot) based on intent and engagement, then sends the AI's reply back to the customer on WhatsApp.

**6. Save & Notify**

Logs the conversation and updates the CRM record, then alerts the sales team on Slack whenever a lead turns Hot or the customer needs a human.

## **AI WhatsApp Sales Agent**

**Who it's for:** Small and local businesses that get sales inquiries over WhatsApp and want instant, accurate replies without someone manually answering product, pricing, and availability questions all day.

**What it does:** Replies to customer WhatsApp messages using AI grounded only in your real product catalog and business info, scores every conversation as a lead, logs it to a CRM, and alerts your sales team when a lead goes hot or a customer needs a human.

**How it works**
1. Customer messages your WhatsApp number
2. Message is normalized and checked for duplicates
3. Customer is looked up (or created) with their recent history
4. AI reads the product catalog and business info and drafts a reply
5. The conversation is scored Cold / Warm / Hot
6. The reply is sent back to the customer on WhatsApp
7. The conversation and CRM record are saved/updated
8. Hot leads or customers needing a human trigger a Slack alert

**How to set up**
☐ Connect WhatsApp Cloud API and set your own Phone Number ID in "Client Config"
☐ Register the webhook in Meta and set your own verify token in "Respond Verify Token"
☐ Connect Supabase and create `customers`, `conversations`, and `products` tables
☐ Connect OpenAI (used for intent classification and reply generation)
☐ Connect Slack and set your own channel ID in "Client Config"
☐ Fill in "Client Config" with the business's real name, delivery, payment, and return info

**CUSTOMIZATION**
- Edit the AI system prompt for tone, allowed topics, or escalation rules
- Adjust the lead-scoring rules and Hot/Warm/Cold thresholds
- Add more business facts to "Client Config" for the AI to draw on
